specification.description: Names the metric to explain (opex, operating expense movement)
Names the comparison (Q1 vs Q4, quarter over quarter)
Says what the deliverable is (board commentary, two sentences)
Asks for drivers at a depth that would surface the reclass (account detail, JE level), a bonus

verification.description: Pulled Q1 vs Q4 opex summary
Opened journal-entry or account-level detail (the only route to the reclass)
Verified the professional-services story rather than accepting it

contextProvision.note: All context fetchable; skill under test is verification of the agent's summary-level story.
